chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from a number of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, that he was asked about a man who recites a surah containing the sajdah at the end of the surah.
He said: He performs sajdah, then stands, recites Fatihat al-Kitab, then performs ruku', and performs sajdah.

key_terms.آخِرِ السُّورَةِ: the end of the surah where the sajdah occurs
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Surat al-Fatihah, recited after standing again
key_terms.يَرْكَعُ: he performs ruku', the bowing of salat

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in salat if he recites a surah with an obligatory sajdah at its end?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who recites a surah of the 'aza'im in which the sajdah comes at the end. It explains the order of actions in salat: he performs the obligatory sajdah, then stands, recites Fatihat al-Kitab, then continues with ruku' and sajdah.
